_doc: Layered avatar wardrobe. Each item is generated per figure by scripts/avatar/layers.py: Flux Kontext edits the figure's base (or its green-suit copy for clothing), the base is subtracted, and what changed is the layer. tint:true items are drawn in grey and coloured at runtime. See docs/AVATAR-LAYERS.md. starter:true items are free from account setup (all hair, and the everyday tops, legs and shoes); everything else is earned.
